free_front_door: CONFIRMED at the source, in the manufacturers' own words, for most of the channel. Of 20 manufacturer or hub pages read, 13 bundle label/identity design in-house. Multlabel says outright 'Criamos fórmulas, rótulos e embalagens sem custo adicional'. At least 7 bundle marketing beyond the label: DC Beauty runs an in-house 'AGÊNCIA DE PUBLICIDADE · AGÊNCIA DE MARKETING DIGITAL' with '3D, … produtora de vídeos e animações, retoque de imagens' and 'CAMPANHAS' (the launch kit itself, #12 by notifications); Pack for You sells 'Publicidade' and 'assessoria de marketing completa'; SDK sells 'materiais promocionais'; Vonshér 'suporte de marketing'; Stoa 'marketing digital / marketing de conteúdo'; Nossa Fábrica 'marketing estratégico'; Frosini 'Branding … equipe de marketing'. The #1 notifier's legal entity is literally an 'AGÊNCIA DE PUBLICIDADE'. This is THE NO-MARGIN-ON-THE-FLOW LAW exactly: the factory earns on the production flow, so it gives the design and marketing layer away to win the order. The packshot layer is free a second way: label designers include a photorealistic 3D mockup with every label (Orbe R$200 'Mockup 3D incluso'; BeHub 'Mockups 3D fotorrealistas inclusos … PNG/JPG'), so the micro-brand already holds a clean product image on the day its label is approved. What is NOT bundled by most is lifestyle scenes plus short film. That increment sells at R$20-100 per unit on Vintepila and R$53/image or R$260/video at a SP studio. Only 3 of 20 explicitly push design OUT to the client: Veneza (the #2 notifier, and the one real opening), Private and Florus (both by referral). The #1, #3, #5 and #6 notifiers (Suportt, Império, TCI, Alfahair) could not be read (DNS failure, reset or 503), so the top of the list is UNVERIFIED either way.
resale_evidence: NO evidence that any manufacturer RESELLS a third party's creative service with a markup. What exists: (a) in-house bundling (DC Beauty, Pack for You, SDK and others above), which makes these manufacturers competitors, not resellers; (b) REFERRAL to partner designers (Florus 'indicações de fornecedores … Designers'; Private 'indicamos parceiros especialistas em branding e design gráfico'; Veneza 'o cliente pode contratar designer/agência de preferência'), in which the client pays the partner directly and each client remains a separate sale; (c) per-item add-on fees on the order form. Veneza charges 'Taxa por produto: R$ 437,50 por item' for ANVISA regularização and sells samples. This is the ONE structural precedent for a 'Kit Lançamento R$X por item' line, but it is the manufacturer's own service, not a resold one. Adjacent matchmaking exists: ABC's 'Terceiriza Beauty' matches brands to member terceiristas for free. No manufacturer partner or agency programme for visuals was found (search 'agências parceiras / programa de parceiros' returned nothing relevant).

arithmetic.kits_per_mfr_month: Recomputed from TA_CONSULTA_COSMETICOS.CSV, 12 months to 23 Sep 2026: electronic notifications only, midnight-stamped legacy rows dropped, exact-name re-notifications dropped, clustered per brand key at >21-day gaps. Launch windows per month: Veneza 35,2 · Briefing/Suportt 28,2 · Império 22,2 · SDK 21,1 · TCI 15,5 · HF/Vonshér 14,3 · Alfahair 13,8 · DC Beauty 9,6 · Século 9,2 · Emapem 8,8 · RS de Vargas 8,4 · Evolutions 8,1 · Cosmoética 7,8 · Pack to You 7,7 · Marliere 7,4 · AJ 6,9 · JK 5,8 · WB 2,8 · Cosmo 2,5 · Nossa Fábrica 2,0 · Florus 1,0. New brand keys per month (first appearance at that holder): Veneza 21 · Briefing 15 · Império 15 · SDK 14 · HF 10 · Alfahair 7,5 · TCI/DC 6 · Pack 5,7. Across all 158 manufacturer-like holders (≥50 notifications, ≥10 brand keys, known own-brand houses excluded): 8.261 windows/yr and 5.098 new brand keys/yr, both UPPER BOUNDS (brand-key precision ~85%; split keys inflate counts). Clients are micro: most holders and brands are ME porte, and Veneza's entry order is R$5.000. Two corrections to H6A. (1) The '73% made by multi-brand manufacturers' is definition-sensitive: recounted with 12-month brand keys it is 55% (917/1.667). (2) The '58 manufacturers = 30%' becomes 56 = 29,3%, and 52 = 27,7% once Unilever, Boticário, Natura and Gram/Haskell (own-brand multi-line houses) are removed.
arithmetic.price_per_kit: Observed replacement band for 6 lifestyle images + 1 short film, bought by a micro-brand: ≈R$149 (Vintepila gigs) to R$578 (a SP studio's published AI lines). The packshot is already free inside a R$200 label. Sold to a MANUFACTURER, the ceiling is its own cost: an in-house designer (13 of 20 have one) plus US$49/month of Higgsfield. That implies a wholesale price of ~R$50-150 per kit (ESTIMATE; designer hourly cost UNVERIFIED). Realistic retail to a micro-brand: R$300-500. H6A's R$1.500-2.500 is 3-17× the observed band and should be dropped.
arithmetic.mfrs_needed: Bar ≈R$150-190k/yr gross = R$12.500-15.800/month. At R$300/kit that is 42-53 kits/month; at R$500/kit, 25-32. Assume a partner converts 20% of NEW brands (UNVERIFIED): a Veneza-class partner gives ~4 kits/month and a mid-tier one (6-10 new brands/month) 1-2. So 6-12 referral partners are needed at R$500, and 10-20+ at R$300. They must come from the ~1/3 of manufacturers that do not bundle design in-house. Market-multiple on paper: 8.261 windows × R$400 = R$3,3M/yr, and ÷4 = R$826k > bar. So the pool is not the constraint. Willingness to pay above the R$20-100 gig price and the manufacturers' free bundle are.
arithmetic.hours: From H6D: packshot-in-scene still 12-30 min, film 120-360 min at the start. A kit of 6 packshot-in-scene stills + 1 short camera-move motion + 3 ratios + QA = 2,6-5,7 h at the start and ~1,5-3 h after learning (ESTIMATE). A stock-bottle template library per manufacturer could bring it to ~1-1,5 h (UNVERIFIED). Veneza's packaging catalogue is a 30-page image-only PDF with no text to count SKUs from. Capacity: 87 h less 15-20 h of calls/sales ≈ 67-72 h ⇒ 22-48 kits/month at 1,5-3 h. So 42-53 kits at R$300 is over capacity, and 25-32 kits at R$500 fits only at ≤2,5 h/kit.

strongest_version: Drop resale. Keep ONE referral leg and make it a machine. 'KIT DE LANÇAMENTO NO DIA DO RÓTULO' for Veneza-class manufacturers, the minority that push design to the client. The trigger is label approval, the date Veneza's 30-day production clock starts ('o prazo começa a contar somente após a aprovação do rótulo'). Sol receives the client's print-ready label PDF and the stock-bottle code. It arrives as files, so C4 is clean. She maps the label onto that manufacturer's stock-bottle geometry and composites it into pre-built lit scenes without regenerating the label. She delivers 6 lifestyle stills + 1 camera-move motion + marketplace set within 5 days, i.e. ~25 days BEFORE stock exists, so the micro-brand can open pre-sales, Shopee/ML listings and Instagram teasers on day 1. It is fidelity-guaranteed ('any character that differs from your approved PDF is redone free'), which prices off the one thing the R$20 gig does not promise. Sold at R$390 per SKU line (≤3 SKUs) in Portuguese calls to brands the manufacturer refers, or listed next to the R$437,50 ANVISA fee if a manufacturer will add a line. The ANVISA daily file supplies extra direct leads: brands notified under manufacturer CNPJs. Preferences traded away: ORIGINATION-ONCE is lost, because every micro-brand is a fresh sale and the manufacturer only refers. The MACHINE TEST is mostly kept (template + composite). TREADMILL: a frontier release makes the manufacturer's in-house designer able to do it alone, so it moves toward OBSOLETE. This is an add-on leg or lead-in for a bigger ticket, not a business.
honest_floor_usd_month: US$0-300/month. That is 0-5 kits/month from 1-2 referral partners at R$390, less ~15% tax/fees and ~R$330/month of tools, at PTAX ≈5,18. The realistic ceiling with 4-6 partners and 20-30 kits/month is R$7.800-11.700/month gross ≈ US$1.200-1.900/month net, still below the US$2.000-2.500 bar and needing 30-90 h/month.
next_test: R$0, Portuguese calls, 10 working days, both legs. (A) Call 10 manufacturers that do NOT show in-house design: Veneza, Império, TCI, Alfahair, Suportt, Emapem/Liège, Carpe/Marliere, RS de Vargas/RB, AJ/Trizzi, JK Fórmulas. Ask: 'Quem produz hoje as fotos e vídeos de lançamento dos seus clientes de marca própria, e quanto eles pagam?' and 'Vocês colocariam um Kit de Lançamento de R$390 por linha no pedido, como a taxa ANVISA, ou indicariam formalmente no onboarding?' (B) From the ANVISA feed, take 20 brands notified in the last 14 days under those manufacturers' CNPJs. Find each on Instagram or its site and call. Ask what they paid for label + mockup and what they will spend on launch images/video.
bar: Committed in advance. The channel is DEAD unless ≥2/10 manufacturers agree IN WRITING within 30 days to list or formally refer the kit, AND ≥5/20 micro-brands say they paid or will pay ≥R$300 for launch images/video beyond the free label mockup. If either leg misses, stop. If both clear, pilot 10 paid kits at R$390 and kill it if the stopwatch median exceeds 2,5 h/kit.
